import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== WK26 DEEP DIAG day {day} ===\n")

# Net change by group: new subs (start in last 7d) vs cancels (end in last 7d)
print("--- Per-group flow last 7d (new active vs cancelled vs lost) ---")
for g in ['S1','S2','S3','D_S07','D_S10']:
    r = nm.query(f"""SELECT 
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day > {day-7} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as new_subs,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.end_day > {day-7} AND s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancels
      FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
      WHERE c.group_id='{g}'""")
    row = r['rows'][0]
    print(f"  {g}: new_subs(7d)={row['new_subs']} cancels(7d)={row['cancels']}")

# Active count now by group
print("\n--- Active subs now by group/plan ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price) as mrr
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']:6} {row['plan']}: {row['n']:7} subs MRR ${row['mrr']:,.0f}")

# S2 cancels by plan/price to see if planA or planB churning
print("\n--- S2 cancels last 7d by plan ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT s.plan, s.effective_price, COUNT(*) as n
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.end_day > {day-7} AND s.status='cancelled'
  GROUP BY s.plan, s.effective_price ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']} @${row['effective_price']}: {row['n']}")

# S1 re-bill survival isolation: S1 planA billing events last 7d
print("\n--- S1 planA: payments vs cancels last 7d (re-bill survival) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) as pays FROM ledger l 
  WHERE l.category='subscription_payment' AND l.day > {day-7} AND l.amount=26""")
# can't easily join ledger to group; approximate via subscriptions
print("  (approx via $26 bucket in rebill.py)")
